plain_english: Of things, the two courses that go by being and non-being — leaping over them — to the third, the wondrous Śambhu — bow.
sanskrit_cite: sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ | tām ullaṅghya tṛtīyasmai namaś citrāya śambhave

plain_english: Among gods, seers, and men in this unfree triple world — free are Your dependents, O Free One.
sanskrit_cite: āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye | svatantrās te svatantrasya ye tavaivānujīvinaḥ

plain_english: Remembrance of Your body inlaid with the whole universe — the one medicine for world-pain; who have it sit happy.
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ | yeṣām bhavarujām ekaṃ bheṣajaṃ te sukhāsinaḥ

plain_english: Whose white umbrella is the self-lit moon, whose fly-whisk the heaven-river's stream — He alone is Supreme Lord.
sanskrit_cite: sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ svaprabhāparipūritaḥ | cāmaraṃ svardhunīsrotaḥ sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ

plain_english: Grant me, Lord, a glance — luminous, cool, one, pure as a moon-digit, carrying nectar.
sanskrit_cite: prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ śuddhāṃ śaśikalām iva | dṛśaṃ vitara me nātha kām apy amṛtavāhinīm

plain_english: Fallen from Your consciousness-bliss ocean — these knowings, these drops — why are they not nectar-sweet-beautiful to me, Lord?
sanskrit_cite: tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ | imāḥ kathaṃ me bhagavan nāmṛtāsvādasundarāḥ

plain_english: In Your love-rasa, Lord, hearts unmelted — the heartless alone — such deserve contempt.
sanskrit_cite: tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ prabho | yeṣām ahṛdayā eva te 'vajñaspadam īdṛśāḥ

plain_english: Whose heart has met the Lord's — he alone is the vessel of ruling goddesses' powers.
sanskrit_cite: prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam | prābhavīṇāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paramekaḥ sa bhājanam

plain_english: Flooder alike of all joys and sorrows — Your meditation-nectar-flood, like lowlands filling.
sanskrit_cite: harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam | bhavaddhyānāmṛtāpūro nimnāṇimnabhuvām iva

plain_english: What would their look not be, happiness-provisions-full — who never part from You, more than self, Lord?
sanskrit_cite: keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā | yeṣām ātmādhikeneśa na kvāpi virahas tvayā

plain_english: I roar, I dance — my wishes are fulfilled, for my Lord is won, utterly charming.
sanskrit_cite: garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ | svāmī mamaiṣa ghaṭito yat tvam atyantarocanaḥ

plain_english: Where no other knowable for action, no other yoga for knowing — yet what if knowledge? Consciousness alone, world-filled-one, expands.
sanskrit_cite: nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo vidā ca yat | jñānaṃ syāt kiṃ tu viśvaikapūrṇā cittvaṃ vijṛmbhate

plain_english: Suddenly fled from them — hard, endless sorrows — whose speech forever holds the Śiva-sound.
sanskrit_cite: durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te | hastāt palāyitā yeṣāṃ vāci śaśvacchivadhvaniḥ

plain_english: Is there another, higher person, distinct by remaining Yours? You alone, great Person, support of all persons without remainder.
sanskrit_cite: uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti yuṣmaccheṣaviśeṣitaḥ | tvaṃ mahāpuruṣas tv eko niḥśeṣapuruṣāśrayaḥ

plain_english: Victorious, world-venerable, Your slaves, Lord — for whom this saṃsāra-ocean is a play-great-lake.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te jagatāṃ vibho | saṃsārārṇava evaiṣa yeṣāṃ krīḍāmahāsaraḥ

plain_english: Let other miseries sit — for Your devotees, "You manifest Yourself" — by this alone they are shamed.
sanskrit_cite: āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām | tvam eva prakaṭībhūyā ity anenaiva lajjyate

plain_english: "Nothing is beyond me" — yet therein I am a reciter, by that oneness; as truth, You point the rosary somewhere.
sanskrit_cite: matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ | tattvena japa ity akṣamālayā diśasi kvacit

plain_english: From being must come supreme being, and beyond that, Lord — and You are other than being and non-being both; hence You are being-non-being-formed.
sanskrit_cite: sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat sac ca tasmāt paraṃ prabho | tvaṃ cāsataḥ sataś cānyas tenāsi sadasanmayaḥ

plain_english: Purer-shining than thousand-sun-ray-rise — yet You, all-worlds-pervading, are not seen.
sanskrit_cite: sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān | api tvaṃ sarvabhuvanavyāpako 'pi na dṛśyase

plain_english: Conscious-formed in the inert world, knower even in the known; great in the measured — hence You are the highest.
sanskrit_cite: jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ | vibhur mite ca yenāsi tena sarvottamo bhavān

plain_english: Enough with other cries — this alone, before the Lord: I cry sharp, Lord, I am bewildered, even knowing thus.
sanskrit_cite: alam ākranditair anyair iyad eva puraḥ prabhoḥ | tīvraṃ viraumi yan nātha muhyāmy evaṃ vidann api
